query: Please implement a comprehensive file management platform for uploading, downloading, and organizing files. The platform should have functionalities for file upload and download, file organization and categorization, user access control, file encryption, and security protection. Users should be able to log in, upload and download files, organize and categorize files, control file access permissions, and view file access records. Configure all backgrounds with pearl and all components with charcoal.
